llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only Go defensive-coding guide that is internally consistent with its purpose and requests no credentials or risky installs.
llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only guide for defensive Go coding and looks coherent: it declares no required environment variables, has no install step, and only expects the 'go' binary. Before installing: (1) note the skill can run autonomously (the platform default) — that is normal but increases what it can do if combined with other privileges; (2) the skill's allowed-tools include commands like golangci-lint and git even though they are not listed as required binaries—if you do not want the agent to run external linters or git commands, restrict tool permissions; (3) the SKILL.md references other cc-skills (e.g., concurrency, security); those are external pointers only — verify any linked skills you plan to use. No credentials or sensitive system paths are requested, so there is no direct secret-exfiltration risk from the skill itself.
